title: A count or fact about a family's fonts belongs in fm-core, not in a Pinia store
rule: When the UI shows a number or verdict that needs font knowledge (how many styles have a character, how many named instances a variable face counts as, which faces cover a script), do not compute it in a store or component from several API answers. Add an additive fm-api method backed by fm-core (it can read the stored cmap, instances and health directly), wire it through CoreApi, MockApi, fm-client, fm-endpoint and the Tauri command, and let the store only call it and drop stale answers. Test it in fm-core with fixtures and once through the api.rs entry path.
rationale: E42.5 (#456): the 'in N of M styles' count summed per-face answers in stores/glyphs.ts and decided how a variable face counts, which breaks rule 1 and overcounted invisible characters.
